conclusion: R11 is inconclusive and does not pass I167. The public preview was launched with the verified partial GTK2 RC: its argv includes --rc and the native session validates the RC and calls Gtk.rc_parse. recipe_applied=false denotes incomplete/full-theme coverage, not omission of that RC. This source-path evidence does not prove the recipe changed the measured pixels. Input remained nondeterministic under the same target geometry: run 1 passed all four steppers; run 2 got no event at the first horizontal-left target and exited -15. Do not repeat the unchanged click matrix. Subsequent R15/R13 hit tests found XQueryPointer child=0 on the target positions; the stored pixel deltas and 12 native adjustment rows are preserved observations but are not reliable evidence that the stepper was pressed. Treat R11 as input-attribution-invalid, not as a four-arrow pass.
next: R13 establishes a hit-test guard and reproduces pointer child=0 after warping to a mapped preview. Do not infer pressed-state behavior from R11 or R12. Diagnose nested Xephyr input targeting before another click matrix.
